def analyze(I,O):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    res=[]
    for col in sorted(set(sum(I,[]))-{0}):

            interior=[(y,x) for y in range(rmin+1,rmax) for x in range(cmin+1,cmax)]

def solve(I):
    H=len(I); W=len(I[0])
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
    R=[]
    for y in range(H):
        for x in range(W):
            if I[y][x] and not seen[y][x]:
                c=I[y][x]; stack=[(y,x)]; cells=[]
                while stack:
                    p=stack.pop()
                    if seen[p[0]][p[1]]: continue
                    seen[p[0]][p[1]]=True; cells.append(p)
                    for dy in (-1,0,1):
                        for dx in (-1,0,1):
                            q=(p[0]+dy,p[1]+dx)
                            if 0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<W and I[q[0]][q[1]]==c and not seen[q[0]][q[1]]:
                                stack.append(q)
                ys=[p[0] for p in cells]; xs=[p[1] for p in cells]
                rmin=min(ys); cmin=min(xs); hh=max(ys)-rmin+1; ww=max(xs)-cmin+1
                # pick template = most common interior signature among rects
                inn=tuple(tuple(1 if I[rmin+i+1][cmin+j+1]!=0 else 0 for j in range(ww-2)) for i in range(hh-2))
                R.append((c,rmin,cmin,hh,ww,inn))
    from collections import Counter
    counts=Counter((rr[4],rr[5]) for rr in R)
    keyt=max(counts,key=lambda k:-counts[k])[1:]
    _,sr_,scm_,sha_,swa_=keyt  # dimensions of most-common-size group -> use that
    # template pattern: interior of a rect whose inner is nonzero
    src=[r for r in R if any(sum(sum(row)) for row in [r[5]])]
    best=max(src,key=lambda r_: sum(sum(v) for v in r_[5]))
    sr_,scm_,sha_,swa_=best[1],best[2],best[3],best[4]
    blk=[[1 if I[sr_+i][scm_+j]!=0 else 0 for j in range(swa_)] for i in range(sha_)]
    out=[row[:] for row in I]
    for r in R:
        c,rmin,cmin,hh,ww,_=r
        for i in range(hh):
            for j in range(ww):
                out[rmin+i][cmin+j]=blk[i][j]
    return out
